units.source_text: “客人，左手，这样，再往下握一点……”

en.t: Sir, your left hand, like this, grip a little farther down...

units.source_text: 女人悄悄地给他指出，“那边别动，

en.t: the woman quietly showed him. Do not move that side,

units.source_text: 把右手当成杠杆来用，可以省很多力气呢。”

en.t: use your right hand as a lever, and you can save a lot of strength.
